title: Anomaly.Char.Abilities
description: Snapshot (module Anomaly.Char): every ability any source of the character carries, INCLUDING those whose value is 0 (class flags and quest-granted abilities act by presence: PerfectStealth 186 granted at 0 is on), with the same per-source split `abil <n>` shows. Learned-spellbook markers are left out (Anomaly.Spells lists spells). Sent on any change, on subscription and on request.

total.description: the engine's effective value (Player's ability aggregation), NOT always the sum of the sources: see aggregation. 0 while a buff carrying ability 124 suppresses it

aggregation.description: how the engine folds the sources: sum for most; max for 71, 72 and 101; average for 87 (each source averaged into a running value, so the order matters and total is the engine's figure)

sources.description: each source's own sum, as `abil <n>` prints it. null: that source does not carry the ability; 0: it carries it at 0. granted: the character's granted abilities and quest flags with the race's and the class's; worn: equipped items and carried items that apply; spells: active effects, a 0-valued slot counting its rolled magnitude
